title: Preview constructor object phases
changes: Join four constructor animation phases to their authenticated static object lists and expose them in the object-animation viewer.
Show source thresholds and preview their 8-bit counter transitions at a selected rate, stopping when a threshold cannot be exceeded; retain manual graphics, palette and loop controls.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit l19e38kl passed 47 projection, missing-source, playback and regression tests. Initial q2_tbqhn identified a JavaScript inherited-property collision; the catalog key was changed and navigation tests passed on retry.

Protected EUR unit fe1v12d_ authenticated five source spans and compared four phases and eight object descriptors with the source, checked playback in Chrome, preserved 11 scope payloads apart from the intended resource move/view and 144 resource pages, and matched 18 Docker/Python files. Fourteen ignored wiki files were published.
limitations: Graphics and palettes are manually paired; preview tick rate, live task state, affine and other special object modes are not a reconstruction of the game scene. Native Windows remains unverified.
